card.name: Fish stock and fishery management articles
card.fires_on: Ordinary words inside news articles about fish populations and fisheries, such as striped bass and King Crab. It fires on small words and titles just before talk of stocks or their health.

modes.label: Fish survey reporting
modes.description: Small words in sentences about juvenile fish, spawning and year-class surveys.

modes.description: Punctuation or words in a fisheries official's quotes, just before talk of variability or stocks.
modes.example: it would seem that the wild swings are tied to the environment,” Mr<<.>> McKiernan said.

modes.label: Population status
modes.description: Linking words in sentences on whether crab or fish populations are healthy or closed to fishing.
modes.example: Some populations<< are>> closed for fishing, however, to rebuild

card.writes: It pushes toward words like stock, management and recruit, which suggests fish stock and management terms come next.
card.plain: It lights up in fishery news where the next word is likely to be about fish stocks or their management.
